name: Diabetes 130-US Hospitals for Years 1999-2008: Readmission Prediction Benchmark
description: The Diabetes 130-US Hospitals dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository (ID 296) provides 10 years (1999–2008) of clinical encounter data from 130 hospitals and integrated delivery networks across the United States. Comprising 101,766 verified inpatient encounters from diabetic patients, the dataset includes 50 detailed attributes describing patient demographics, admission type, discharge disposition, medical specialty, up to three ICD-9 diagnoses, number of lab procedures, medications administered (including detailed diabetic regimens: insulin, metformin, sulfonylureas), and HbA1c test results. The primary clinical task is predicting 30-day hospital readmission to support quality-of-care improvements.
